text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――Early December.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, it is time to accelerate toward the 
future. For the race that begins is not 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The particle accelerator has been running 
since long ago! As one who runs on the 
cutting edge of it all!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Yes, this is it, this is 
exactly what it's like!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon claims an overwhelming 
victory in her Debut! An astonishing run 
that keeps accelerating even after the 
finish line!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Her talent is extraordinary. Even so, with 
this being her first victory, aiming for a 
GⅠ this year will be tough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Strict? Are you still half-asleep? At this 
rate, that isn't light—it's an earthworm! 
A mere worm!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The Hopeful Stakes is just around the 
corner, isn't it? Well then, until next 
time."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Tachyon!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
See, Trainer? Just like I said. They 
actually managed to make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Still, the way she ran...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't believe my eyes. The explosive 
acceleration that overtakes you in an 
instant is an absolute menace. The speed 
of light itself..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if we can beat 'em next time. 
But next year...! Yeah, me and Tsuzuki can 
do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after the Asahi Hai FS—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Tsuzuki's running was impressive 
as expected. Even if it doesn't quite 
match Tachyon's.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If it's like that, I can definitely make 
it next year. I'll do my best in the 
upcoming Hopeful Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, Tsuzuki? No, it's from Tsuzuki's 
phone, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's not Tsuzuki. It's from someone 
connected to her. Why would someone 
related to her...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Im... possible... She was totally fine 
right after the race. Why...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wee-woo, wee-woo...)

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... Pokke...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tsuzuki... Tsuzu... ki... You've gotta be 
kidding me...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
The diagnosis was... a fracture beyond 
full recovery. It seems... a comeback is 
not to be expected.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: O-Ooooh... Why... How could this be...!?

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"They say there's a high probability it 
had already occurred during the race."

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
They told me, "It was a blessing in 
disguise that you were able to cross the 
finish line safely and got away with just 
this."

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
The muscle I built up through our 
countless training sessions... might have 
just saved my life.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: DAMMIIIIIIT!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket rushed back to her old 
stomping grounds... and holed herself up 
all alone in the hangout spot.

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Pokke-san seems pretty agitated, 
doesn't she...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsuzuki Reigning's indefinite hiatus from 
racing. I understand all too well just how 
much of a shock it was.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat Tachyon. We're definitely going to 
pull it off, Pokke!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You don't even need to say it. The two of 
us'll take 'em on! And I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How painful it must be when a peer—someone 
you raced alongside and shared ambitions 
with— is forced to retire.

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You used to be much more aloof, Pokke-san.

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
They didn't call me the "Demon of Roaring 
Battles" for nothing. I won't falter just 
because one or two people go down.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...You're quitting the team? Then go. 
I've got no lingering regrets for those 
who leave. But—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Leave behind whatever dream you had. 
Sounds like it was way out of your league 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: RRYAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"So she ran the next race with that much 
more determination, huh. Though it wasn't 
as wild as today."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The difference between then and now. I 
don't know what it means. But...
choice_data_list:
Thanks, I'll try talking to them for a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Sorry... Is it okay if I talk to you...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I'm fine. I just... can't accept 
this. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tsuzuki's running... Her running, which 
was so infuriatingly flawless...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Never... again... You've got to be kidding 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her teammates said she's the "type who 
doesn't let things bother her." Yet Jungle 
Pocket right now looks nothing like that.
choice_data_list:
You're right. Feelings don't change that 
quickly...

You're right. Feelings don't change that 
quickly...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm... I'm fine. I should be fine. 
Something like this is nothing...
choice_data_list: Pokke... don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Struggling...? Me...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's not like me. The old me 
wouldn't have cared about something like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't give a damn what happens to the 
others. I'll turn even parting into 
strength—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Never looking back, only moving forward. 
Charging ahead with a fierce drive—that 
was me in my freelance days.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: How could that be...
choice_data_list:
Maybe our feelings were just connected 
that deeply...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Guess our feelings reached each other, 
huh? Hah, that's totally not like me...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Then again, that might be true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no mistaking it. But somehow, even 
so, somehow...
choice_data_list:
I know it's painful, but... push forward 
somehow!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...I knooow.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry so much. Even if my heart 
breaks into pieces, I ain't stopping."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I made a promise to you, partner. That 
one day, we're definitely gonna make it to 
the top."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'm fine now. I'll overcome it 
just like I always have. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It just took a little longer than before. 
...Just enough time to dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—the time for farewell.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: So, Tsuzuki. What're you gonna do now?

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to help out with my father's 
business for a while. He's expanding all 
sorts of things and asked for my help.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Elites sure have a lot going on. 
That's a world I don't understand.”

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Pokke, I've been thinking non-stop about 
what to say to you. But nothing good comes 
to mind. Just...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Our dream—has not ended.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"The days of dreaming to defeat Tachyon 
aren't over yet. That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: ...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The train pulled away. Right on schedule, 
after a few dry words were exchanged.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Piece of shit.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You don't even need to tell me that. 
Right, partner?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Screw this. No way in hell... I'm 
stopping here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The quiet indignation exhaled by Jungle 
Pocket faded away into the open sky.
